{"id":1987022819,"question_id":3026,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 4 weeks","timestamp":1777038342,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1987022819/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Minimum Possible Sum of a Beautiful Array","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n    int minimumPossibleSum(int n, int target) {\n        int sum = 0;\n        int size = 0;\n\n        if(n == 1 and target == 1) return 1;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<=1e9 ; i++)\n        {\n            if(sum + i == target) continue;\n            sum += i;\n            size++;\n            if(size == n) break;\n        }\n        return sum % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-minimum-possible-sum-of-a-beautiful-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1937}
